I wrote `priorities.csv` to `/tmp/psz-work/calib2/t1h_tickets/stock/0/priorities.csv` with 39 rows, sorted by id.

I applied the rules by hand, not with a script. I left out the 6 closed tickets (T-200, T-216, T-220, T-238, T-242), which leaves 45 − 6 = 39 rows.

Two matching decisions affect the output:
- **"Refunded?"** does not match `refund` as a whole word, so the subject alone would not trigger P3. T-226, T-232 and T-233 still get P3 because their bodies say "Has my refund been processed?".
- **"Planned downtime" and "Breakdown per region"** do not match `down`, because whole-word matching excludes them. T-205, T-211 and T-241 therefore get P4.
